title: Same Day Card Grading (2026)
verdict: Same day card grading is available from AGS for urgent submissions, by arrangement, and its posted tiers return cards in 5, 10 or 20 business days.

Faster posted tiers exist if you will pay for them. Beckett Priority is 2 to 3 business days at $124.95 a card, and CGC Express is 5 working days at $50. ISA lists 14 days at $15 with a 10-card minimum. PSA's listed value tiers run 25 to 45 business days.

why: Turnaround is counted in days. AGS quotes 20 business days or less from the day your cards are confirmed, with 10 and 5 business day bulk tiers at $20 and $30 a card.

One price covers everything. $18 buys the scan, the grade, eight subgrades, the report and the slab, for any card at any value. Orders of 30 or more TCG cards pay $15 a card on the standard bulk tier.

You see why the card got its grade. AGS issues eight subgrades, four for the front and four for the back, plus a defect list and a 3D heightmap. Most graders hand back one number. A buyer who can open the report has less to argue about.

faq.q: Who offers same day card grading?
faq.a: AGS says same-day grading is available for urgent submissions. Contact AGS first to arrange timing and price. The quickest posted tiers elsewhere are Beckett Priority at 2 to 3 business days for $124.95 and CGC Express at 5 working days for $50.

faq.q: Can I get a card graded the same day?
faq.a: AGS says same-day grading is available for urgent submissions. Contact AGS before you ship or drop off to arrange it. Elsewhere, the quickest posted tiers are 2 to 5 business days and cost $50 to $150 a card.

faq.q: What grading scale does AGS use?
faq.a: 1 to 10 with decimal precision. An AGS 10 is near-perfect measurable condition. A 9.5 has minor flaws that do not significantly affect condition.

faq.q: Can I cross a card over from another grader's slab?
faq.a: CGC and Ace Grading list crossover services. AGS's FAQ does not list one, so ask AGS before sending a card in another company's holder.
Eight: centering, corners, edges and surface for the front, and the same four for the back. They are included in the price and shown in the digital report.
